newsitem.title: USA: Regis Corp sets rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Regis Corp sets rights plan.

text.p: Regis Corp said on Tuesday it has adopted a shareholder rights plan to assure that its shareholders are treated fairly, if there is a proposed takeover.
The rights plan, which goes into effect when a group or person attempts to buy 20 percent of the company without board approval, is not a response to any known takeover attempt, the company said.
If the rights become exercisable, they entitle all holders, except the take-over bidder, to purchase Regis shares at a discount, the hair salon company said.
The rights will not prevent a takeover, but should encourage anyone seeking to acquire the company to negotiate with the board prior to attempting a takeover, Regis said.
The rights are attached to all shares of the company's common stock as of December 23, 1996, the company said.
